title: Shiftory agent-quality capture protocol registry
description: A machine-readable, versioned freeze of the exact capture protocol (predeclared configurations, prompt-package digests, and invocation/output/access rules) committed BEFORE any capture generation it governs. A capture's agent-run-v2.benchmark_protocol_commit records the commit that added or last matched this file; agent_harness.recompute_benchmark_protocol_commit_verification independently reconstructs and checks the full prompt package against that commit, and a capture's own capture_ingested_at_utc must be later than that commit's committer date (checked by validate_protocol_precommitment), so the freeze is provably both content-correct and chronologically prior to generation -- not merely selected afterward to match a result.

unique_prompt_directory_per_invocation.description: Every (case, config) pair must be materialized into its own directory, never shared with any other invocation -- the defect this invariant closes: an earlier attempt at this registry revision materialized one directory per CASE (shared across both configs), so two sub-agents wrote RAW_RESPONSE to the same path and one silently overwrote the other before either was read. See invalidated-generation-attempt-v1 records for the resulting unrecoverable lost attempts.

output_directory_must_not_preexist.description: capture_result's out_dir must not already exist (or contain prior invocation artifacts) before a new invocation writes to it; a preexisting/reused output directory must refuse, never silently merge or overwrite.

exclusive_directory_creation.description: Both the prompt-package directory and the output directory are created with exclusive (fail-if-exists) semantics bound to case+config+protocol revision, so two invocations racing for the same directory fail loudly instead of one clobbering the other.

case_revisions.description: case_id -> the case.json 'version' a capture must be generated against for it to be considered governed by this registry revision.

prior_incidents.description: Optional disclosure of prior registry revisions this revision supersedes because of a real, documented protocol defect (not merely a content update) -- e.g. the registry_version 2 shared-directory RAW_RESPONSE collision that produced six unrecoverable lost generation attempts. Never used to retroactively justify or excuse a defect; only to acknowledge it plainly in the same commit that fixes it.
